description:
Your microphone as a radio station for the people you share the board with. The hkp-rt runtime in the Readymade app captures the mic, encodes it to MP3 and sends it over a WebSocket of its own to an hkp-node relay, which serves the player page and passes the stream to every listener. Deployed as a cloud board, it keeps broadcasting with nobody watching for as long as the app runs.

Only the board's owner goes on air. Whoever the board is shared with opens the link they were sent and is shown the player's address; nobody else is told it. The address is a mount — unguessable rather than guarded — so to cut off somebody who has had it, give the relay's mountName a new value and deploy again: everybody still on the list is shown the new one.

Deploy it from the Readymade desktop app: the Home runtime is the hkp-rt it embeds (`embedded`), and the Relay runs on the hkp-node you keep as the remote `node`, which has to be reachable from wherever your listeners are. Give the secret radio-ingest a value when asked: the relay accepts a stream only from whoever presents it. The encoder's channels must match what the Microphone panel reports under Channels: 1 for a built-in mic, 2 for most interfaces.
